summary: RingCentral filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026, reporting that its board rescheduled the 2026 Annual Meeting from November 2 to December 7, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Pacific. Because the new date falls within 25 days of the one-year anniversary of the December 31, 2025 annual meeting, the outside-the-13D deadlines reverted to the original proxy disclosures. Non-Rule 14a-8 proposals or nominations must be received between September 25 and October 25, 2026, and comply with bylaws and Rule 14a-19. Rule 14a-8 proposals remain due October 9, 2026. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; no activist campaign is disclosed.
